title: Covalent targeting of PSMD14 by Eupalinolide B induces oncoprotein degradation and apoptosis in acute promyelocytic leukemia cells
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2026, 7,433-443
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00197H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zheng Chu, Liting Xu, Honglin Chen, Tianyun Fan, Xueqian Hu, Yin Kwan Wong, Qiaoli Shi, Junzhe Zhang, Chengchao Xu, Jigang Wang, Huan Tang
Eupalinolide B covalently targets PSMD14, inhibiting its deubiquitinase activity. This leads to degradation of oncoproteins AKT1 and CDK4, resulting in cell cycle arrest and apoptosis in leukemia cells.
